pages.summary: Elsie confirma que las cuatro alumnas estaban en su taller y deja sin respuesta a Snape.

panels.scene: Oak office door opens. Elsie enters upright in navy healer robe, gray bun glasses and eagle pendant. Hermione seated by sand stroller turns toward her. One small Puffskein and human Robin.
panels.caption: Antes de que Hermione respondiera, se abrió la puerta.

panels.scene: Elsie addresses the director and teachers with a calm professional face. Hermione visibly relieved at left. Right side Katie still has the pumpkin helmet.
dialogue: Elsie: Las cuatro estaban en mi taller, profesor.

panels.scene: Snape in plain black high collar near fireplace raises eyebrow. His long black hair is distinct from the student bob. McGonagall looks on.
dialogue: Snape: ¿De qué clase estamos hablando?

panels.scene: Elsie smiles pleasantly, folding hands at waist and addressing Snape. Two distinct adults, figures fully clothed.
dialogue: Elsie: Respiración y comunicación. Puede acompañarnos el miércoles.

panels.scene: Snape takes half a step back, too surprised to respond. Dumbledore's eyes smile above half-moon glasses. One burly wood desk and silver instruments.
panels.caption: Snape no encontró una respuesta.

panels.scene: McGonagall resumes questioning, stern hand on desk. Elsie nods seriously, not smiling now.
dialogue: McGonagall: Eso no explica el duelo en el pasillo.

pages.summary: Elsie pregunta por qué volvieron las Hufflepuff. El grupo discute cómo ocurrieron las transformaciones.

panels.scene: Elsie beside left edge of desk turns to Diane and pumpkin-head Katie on right. Diane holds folded cloth and listens with increasing unease.
dialogue: Elsie: Ustedes salieron antes. Cuando yo me fui, el pasillo estaba vacío.

panels.scene: Close Elsie with calm investigative eyebrow, blue sapphire eagle pendant and gray bun. Diane's blond hair at edge.
dialogue: Elsie: ¿Por qué regresaron?

panels.scene: Diane stammers silently. Katie in intact orange pumpkin helmet lifts one hand and speaks, clear balloon tail toward pumpkin. Human Phoenix in wicker bassinet reaches for her from safe distance.
dialogue: Katie: ¡Se nos olvidó un juguete de Phoenix!

panels.scene: Dumbledore leans forward on the carved desk, hands apart, curious eyes, no malice. Both strollers outside framing.
dialogue: Dumbledore: ¿Y cómo terminaron con un Puffskein y una calabaza?

panels.scene: Hermione dust on red-gold robe, sapphire and curls intact. Robin cradles the charcoal green-eyed Puffskein beside her, upright in his sand stroller.
dialogue: Hermione: Katie transformó a Pansy. Su hechizo tardará horas en pasar.

panels.scene: Diane raises her chin beside pumpkin-head Katie, looking toward Hermione. Small charcoal Puffskein in left foreground begins to bristle, separate from Robin.
dialogue: Diane: Si controlaras tu carácter, esto no habría pasado.

pages.transcript:

Elsie: ¿Por qué regresaron?

pages.review: Seis viñetas. La calabaza tiene la ranura de la página 16. Diane, Elsie y Dumbledore se distinguen. El Puffskein se ve separado de Robin.

pages.summary: Pansy protesta incluso transformada. Dumbledore envía a Katie y Diane a la enfermería.

panels.scene: Small round charcoal Puffskein springs and catches only the loose yellow-trim fabric of Diane’s raised sleeve. Diane startled, no injury or skin bite. Hermione at left reaches out with one open hand.
dialogue: Hermione: ¡Pansy, suéltala!

panels.scene: Elsie lifts the little Puffskein away from the sleeve with a soft gold levitation charm. A harmless puff of black fur in air, green eyes and tiny paws, no other animal.
dialogue: Elsie: Wingardium Leviosa.

panels.scene: Elsie sets the one puffskein down beside Robin in his sand stroller. Robin rests a tiny human hand gently on its fur. The baby has his normal smooth skin and human hands. McGonagall stern beyond.
dialogue: McGonagall: ¡Cuatro de nuestras mejores alumnas!

panels.scene: Dumbledore speaks from behind desk, serious with hands loosely folded. Hermione watches attentively. McGonagall and Elsie stand nearby.
dialogue: Dumbledore: Las acciones tienen consecuencias.

panels.scene: Dumbledore gestures toward Sprout, an older woman in patched brown hat. Katie still pumpkin-headed and Diane holding white cloth sit on right.
dialogue: Dumbledore: Pomona, acompáñelas a la enfermería.

panels.scene: Sprout leads Katie and Diane through the oak door. Diane gently guides pumpkin-head Katie by sleeve while their ONE wicker bassinet floats beside her with Phoenix. Hermione and her own family stay at left.
panels.caption: Katie y Diane salieron con la profesora Sprout.

pages.summary: Snape propone el Bosque Prohibido. Los adultos discrepan sobre la seguridad de Robin.

panels.scene: Snape black high collar stands at right by fireplace, hands tucked into black sleeves, stern. Now only Hermione and Robin’s stroller on student side. Dumbledore and McGonagall at desk, Elsie watches.
dialogue: Snape: Que recolecten ingredientes en el Bosque Prohibido.

panels.scene: McGonagall turns sharply toward Snape. Tartan cloak, gray hair and pointed green hat, adult stern expression.
dialogue: McGonagall: ¿De noche? ¿Con un bebé?

panels.scene: Elsie steps forward with professional serious look. Her small gold eagle with blue stone is distinct from Hermione’s oval sapphire. Robin visible safely in his stroller in foreground.
dialogue: Elsie: Soy responsable de su seguridad. Eso queda descartado.

panels.scene: Dumbledore looks at Snape calmly, hands on desk, burgundy and gold sleeves, white beard and half-moon glasses.
dialogue: Dumbledore: No las enviaremos al bosque.

panels.scene: Close human Robin in navy cardigan, green eyes, brown curls, small hand raised, beside little charcoal green-eyed Puffskein. Warm gold lamp, distinct fur and human skin.
dialogue: Robin: ¡Dah!

panels.scene: Snape looks toward Elsie, jaw tight, dark black coat and shoulder-length hair. Use speech bubble tail clear to Snape.
dialogue: Snape: Entonces usted puede cuidar al niño durante el castigo.

panels.scene: Hermione stands at left beside the stroller, direct brown eyes and one hand on its handle. Puffskein and Robin in stroller look up. Hermione's silver sapphire on chest visible.
dialogue: Hermione: Robin se queda con nosotras.

pages.summary: Hermione defiende a Robin. Los profesores acuerdan decidir un castigo justo que tenga en cuenta a ambos bebés.

panels.scene: Hermione speaks firmly beside Robin’s sand stroller, with the Puffskein visible in his arms. Snape listens at right. One natural hand resting on stroller handle.
dialogue: Hermione: Aceptamos un castigo. El cuidado de Robin también es nuestra responsabilidad.

panels.scene: Elsie addresses the adults with calm professional look. Dumbledore listens. Warm office wall and silver instruments.
dialogue: Elsie: También debemos tener en cuenta a Phoenix.

panels.scene: Dumbledore behind desk, folded hands and serious kind eyes. McGonagall at left, Snape at right, different expressions.
dialogue: Dumbledore: Los tres jefes de casa decidirán juntos un castigo justo.

panels.scene: McGonagall raises an eyebrow, pondering. Elsie nods in approval. Hermione listens in left foreground.
dialogue: McGonagall: ¿También con Pomona?
Dumbledore, fuera de cuadro: Las cuatro merecen un trato similar.

panels.scene: Dumbledore looks down past the desk toward tiny charcoal Puffskein in stroller beside Robin. Hermione supports the animal lightly with one hand.
dialogue: Dumbledore: El hechizo debería pasar antes de dormir, señorita Parkinson.

panels.scene: Hermione looks down at the Puffskein. The tiny creature gives her an offended stare and gently tugs the edge of her sleeve with its small paws. Robin smiles.
dialogue: Hermione: Pansy se portará bien, profesor.

panels.scene: Hermione pushes Zephyr through the oak door into a stone corridor, viewed from behind. Robin and the Puffskein safe in the stroller. Distant classmates look back and whisper.
panels.caption: Para entonces, Hogwarts entero hablaba del duelo.

pages.summary: Ginny trae la versión de Gossip Witch. Hermione admite que lanzó el primer hechizo y pide la capa de Harry.

panels.scene: Close newspaper held by Ginny with masthead and one clear headline. Small black-and-white sketch of the sixth-floor corridor. No other readable print.
dialogue: Ginny, fuera de cuadro: Lavender publicó la versión de Diane.

panels.scene: Hermione red-gold uniform, sapphire in white platinum, looks openly at Theo and Ginny. Robin and one charcoal Puffskein in stroller, away from faces.
dialogue: Hermione: Nos insultaron, pero el primer hechizo lo lancé yo.

panels.scene: Theo looks at her in surprise with mouth slightly open. Ginny eyes widen. Both in correct uniforms.
dialogue: Ginny: ¿Tú lanzaste el primero?

panels.scene: Close Hermione, resolute brown eyes and arms folded naturally. Dark green-eyed Puffskein visible over stroller edge beside Robin.
dialogue: Hermione: Nadie se mete con mi familia.

panels.scene: Ginny lowers folded newspaper, concerned. Theo listens beside her. Hermione keeps one hand on stroller handle.
dialogue: Ginny: Diane sigue furiosa. Podría estar preparando algo.

panels.scene: Hermione turns to Theo in torchlit corridor, takes stroller handle. Theo listens, very little background.
dialogue: Hermione: Diles a Blaise y a Daphne que nos vemos en la sala común.

panels.scene: Hermione meets Ginny's gaze with an expectant smile. Ginny nods, long copper hair and clear red-gold school uniform. Theo's bemused face at edge.
dialogue: Hermione: Ginny, necesito la capa de Harry.
Ginny: Yo te la consigo.

pages.summary: Los amigos se reúnen en la sala de estudio. Robin protege a Pansy entre juguetes hasta que llega Millicent.

panels.scene: Wide study room, parents watching padded rug. Blaise dark skin black curls laughs from green chair, Daphne kneels on rug. Robin and Arianna watch small charcoal Puffskein between them. Draco sits on mahogany chair, Tracey nearby.
panels.caption: Una hora después, en la sala de estudio de Slytherin.

panels.scene: Daphne admires the small disgruntled fur ball. Both her hands clasped at chest, long blonde waves and green uniform, no grabbing. Human Robin and Arianna nearby.
dialogue: Daphne: ¡Es la cosa más tierna que he visto!

panels.scene: Human baby Arianna in beige offers one small breadcrumb to the charcoal Puffskein with natural tiny fingers, Daphne supervising a short distance away. Robin places a wooden block beside a plush dragon.
panels.caption: Arianna le ofreció pan. Robin le construyó una fortaleza.

panels.scene: Draco platinum-haired in green school uniform, seated in mahogany chair with visible wooden armrest. Hermione listens tiredly from adjacent sofa. The small fur ball and babies stay at safe distance.
dialogue: Draco: ¿Cómo pudo Brennan hacerle eso?
Hermione: Lanzó un hechizo a ciegas entre el humo.

panels.scene: Tracey high brown ponytail and brown eyes on green armrest, school uniform, asks Hermione who blushes mildly. Daphne beside them.
dialogue: Tracey: ¿Y qué hacían en el sexto piso?

panels.scene: Heavy carved oak door swings open. Millicent in green uniform, distinct long dark brown curls half up, stands in doorway looking alarmed. The room falls quiet. No one hurt.
dialogue: Millicent: ¡Pansy!
